headline: US President Donald Trump demands probe after pre election economic growth data revision
label: NEWS
caption:
US President Donald Trump is calling for an official investigation into pre election economic growth data after the government revised the figures up to 4.3 percent according to Anadolu.

Trump publicly questioned the accuracy and timing of the economic numbers that were released before the vote.

The significant revision has sparked intense political debate over the reliability of official economic reporting.

Investigations into government data releases are rare but can carry major political consequences.
